items.title: KI-gestützte Arbeitswelten WIRKsam gestalten
items.description:
In einer Zeit, in der Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) immer wichtiger wird, stehen auch mittelständische Unternehmen vor der Herausforderung, innovative Technologien erfolgreich in ihre Arbeitsprozesse zu integrieren. Dieses Buch bietet eine praxisnahe Einführung in KI-gestützte Arbeitsprozesse und zeigt, wie Unternehmen im Mittelstand die Potenziale dieser Technologie nutzen können, um Effizienz und Wettbewerbsfähigkeit zu steigern. 
 Im Fokus stehen reale Anwendungsfälle aus verschiedenen Zweigen der produzierenden Industrie. Anhand konkreter Beispiele werden Ausgangssituationen, Ziele und umgesetzte Lösungen dargestellt. Sie verdeutlichen, wie KI nicht nur bestehende Prozesse optimiert, sondern auch neue Wertschöpfungsketten ermöglicht. 
 Zu den behandelten Anwendungsfällen zählt u.a. der Einsatz KI-gesteuerter Robotik in der Bearbeitung von Bauteilen. Dabei wird deutlich, wie Präzision, Qualität und Effizienz gesteigert werden können. 
 Das Open Access Buch beleuchtet zudem die Voraussetzungen und Gestaltungsansätze für eine erfolgreiche KI-Integration – von der Datenaufbereitung über die Definition klarer Anforderungen bis hin zur organisatorischen und strategischen Umsetzung. Es zeigt, welche Prozesse sich für den KI-Einsatz eignen und wie Unternehmen Veränderungen sinnvoll gestalten können. 
 Mit praxisnahen Fallstudien und konkreten Handlungsempfehlungen richtet sich das Buch an Führungskräfte, Projektverantwortliche und Ingenieur:innen im Mittelstand. Es zeigt, wie KI den Weg für zukünftige Innovationen ebnen kann und wie diese Technologie die tägliche Arbeit grundlegend verändert und verbessert. Das Buch "KI-gestützte Arbeitswelten WIRKsam gestalten" ist ein unverzichtbarer Leitfaden für alle, die die Potenziale der künstlichen Intelligenz in ihrem Unternehmen voll ausschöpfen möchten.

items.title: Understanding Cybersecurity for Smart Contracts
items.description:
This book provides a comprehensive introduction to the cybersecurity challenges associated with blockchain-based smart contracts and the rapidly growing decentralized ecosystem. It begins by explaining the foundations of blockchain technology, the evolution and lifecycle of smart contracts, and the programming languages and platforms used to develop them. This book also explores how smart contracts are designed, deployed, and used in real-world applications, highlighting their benefits and the security risks that arise from the automated, immutable execution of code in decentralized systems. 
 Building on this foundation, this book examines the major vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and threats targeting smart contracts, including execution manipulation, access-control flaws, and economic exploits. It also reviews existing analysis tools, vulnerability-detection techniques, and defensive strategies, including secure coding practices, formal verification, runtime monitoring, and governance mechanisms. 
 By integrating theoretical concepts, practical tools, and recent research developments, this professional book provides researchers, developers, and cybersecurity professionals with a structured understanding of smart contract security. It also includes emerging challenges and future directions in this rapidly evolving field.

items.title: Energy Informatics
items.description:
The two-volume set LNCS 16981 + 16982 constitutes the proceedings of the 6th Energy Informatics Academy Conference, EI.A 2026, which took place in Beijing, China, during October 14, 2026. 

The 41 full papers and 13 Short papers included in the proceedings were carefully reviewed and selected from 77 submissions. They focus on a unique perspective on how digitalization is transforming the technical, economic, and societal dimensions of modern energy systems. They were organized in topical sections as follows: 

Part I: Flexibility, Forecasting and Supply in District Heating; Digital Transformation of Buildings into Active Energy Prosumers; HVAC, Thermal Comfort and Building Energy Performance; Trustworthy Data and Language Models for Energy Systems; 

Part II: Probabilistic Forecasting and Decision-Making under Uncertainty; Data- and AI-Driven Energy–Climate–Economy Modeling for Mitigation–Adaptation Transitions; Industrial Systems Under Climate and Energy Uncertainty: Adaptation Readiness, Energy Resilience, and Digital Intelligence; Grid Resilience, Energy Storage and Electric Mobility; From Living Labs to Virtual Testbeds: Experimentation and Validation in Energy Informatics.

items.title: Pattern Recognition. ICPR 2026 International Workshops
items.description: This 5-volume set LNCS 17110-7114 constitutes the proceedings of the ICPR 2026 International Workshops held under the umbrella of the 28th International Conference on Pattern Recognition, ICPR 2026, which took place in Lyon, France, during August 17–22, 2026. Part 1 : Basic theories and methods of simulation science and engineering; Modeling and simulation of complex systems/systems-of-systems, control theory and applications; Modeling and simulation of integrated natural environments and virtual reality environments; Multi-agent simulation and large model agent simulation (LLM-Agent); Physics-informed machine learning, world models, and generative simulation; Parallel and distributed simulation, high-performance simulation, cloud simulation, and edge simulation; Simulation model verification and validation (V&V) technologies. 
Part 2 : Simulation standards, simulation tools, simulation support environments, simulation systems, and simulators; CAE, virtual prototyping, and model-based systems engineering (MBSE); Discrete event system simulation, logistics simulation, production line simulation, and supply chain simulation; Control theory and applications, intelligent simulation optimization and scheduling, industrial internet and simulation, green manufacturing and simulation, intelligent manufacturing and simulation; Control theory and applications, intelligent simulation optimization and scheduling, industrial internet and simulation, green manufacturing and simulation, intelligent manufacturing and simulation; Other new theories, methods, and technologies related to simulation.

items.title: Confessions of an AI Brain
items.description:
Confessions of an AI Brain, Second Edition invites readers to not only to understand how AI works, but to imagine, question, and actively shape the kind of AI ‑ enabled future they want to build. By framing AI as a narrator, the book ventures inside the mind of MIRANDA, a fictional yet technically grounded AI brain that narrates its own coming ‑ of ‑ age in a world saturated with algorithms, data, and digital infrastructure. Blending clear explanations with an engaging first-person voice, the book demystifies how modern AI systems are built, trained, deployed, and governed—without assuming any mathematical or programming background. Along the way, MIRANDA reflects on topics such as learning from data, bias and fairness, neurosymbolic reasoning, agentic AI, foundation models, digital twins, and the infrastructure that makes intelligent services possible. 
 Rather than treating AI as a black box or distant threat, the narrative frames it as a partner in a shared human–machine ecosystem, exploring how artificial and biological minds co ‑ evolve at home, in industry, in cities, and in our creative lives. Through concrete examples — from baby steps in safe sandboxes and “data diets” to multi ‑ agent systems, climate ‑ aware optimization, and AI ‑ assisted art, music, and writing — the book shows how AI can be designed to support sustainability, inclusiveness, and human flourishing. Readers gain an intuitive grasp of core concepts like machine learning styles, attention and transformers, trustworthy and explainable AI, and the role of regulation and ethics, all framed through MIRANDA’s candid “confessions” about its capabilities and limitations. 
 Aimed at curious general readers as well as professionals and students who want a concept-focused overview, Confessions of an AI Brain bridges technical insight and societal reflection in an accessible, story ‑ driven format.
